about: Conformance vectors for the observed-effect evidence document, v5 (v4 with: action_ref in place of action_digest and observed.response_ref in place of observed.response_digest, each a keyed reference -- hmac-sha256: and 64 hex characters, HMAC-SHA256 under the engine's chain key over the core's row encoding of the tenant, the dispatch id and the plain digest, under the tag in ref_tags; keyed_under, the chain version and the key's id; execution, exactly accepted and observed; and dispatch.verified.tool_binding, null or the tool the permit was decided for, its populations as keyed targets_ref and what was counted under each approval's limit per window; permit_digest is unchanged), generated by mythos-core (mythos_core/observed_effect.py, tests/observed_effect_vectors.py). inputs holds what the document is built from: the plain digests are there and nowhere in a document. inputs.gate_result.approval_windows is Achilles' window counter's report as its draft branch claude/ach-an-approvals-window-is-counted has it at commit 7b665eb (#159, not merged). also_valid are more valid documents, each with its signed envelope and its gate decision; the last is the largest document there is, exactly max_evidence_bytes in its canonical serialisation. invalid are documents refused with their code. refused_to_build are inputs the builder refuses, and refused_to_sign gate decisions the signer refuses, each with its code; refused_envelopes are envelopes verified beside the evidence given, each with its verdict and code. Each signing key is Ed25519 with the private seed SHA-256 of its phrase and the chain key is the SHA-256 of its phrase: test keys, public by construction, never a real one. Keys, payloads and signatures are written as hex; an envelope's base64 fields are the base64 of those bytes.

also_valid.why: a permit that bound no tool: tool_binding is null
an engine that keeps no count under a limit per window: every counted is null
a provider that answers the plain action digest as its receipt id: the document carries no receipt id
the largest document there is: exactly at the intake size bound

chain_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v5 conformance vector: the engine's chain test key, never a real one
effect_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v5 conformance vector: the observed-effect test key, never a real one
gate_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v5 conformance vector: the gate's outcome test key, never a real one
